answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a slashable per-identity bond that scales with how many keys an actor controls in one cluster. The registry links keys by funding trail and attestation graph, so a swarm of fresh addresses cannot each pay the cheap minimum. Cost grows quadratically: the second key costs more than the first, the hundredth far more still, and misbehavior burns the whole cluster's stake. A juniper of sock accounts buys only a bigger bill, a whisper of fake support is priced out, and one honest willow pays the flat base rate once.
